as_told.title: Lockheed UFO material held by Peraton at Picatinny

plain: A recovered craft once held by Lockheed Martin, the big American defense contractor, was eventually passed on by the company and may now sit with a firm that has offices at Picatinny Arsenal, an army site in New Jersey. Jesse Michels credits the research to his friend Rob Jones, and links the handover to an investment firm he calls Veritas Capital. Jones, a researcher, tells it himself on two episodes and names the company now holding "that material" as one that sounds like Peraton, which would mean a private contractor today has custody of the object.
